description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Construction' card and map layer in the
Development section.

How many development applications for new dwellings were lodged in each
mesh block of the suburb, from the newest 2,000 applications.
Every block is listed, 0 where none were. The individual applications are
at ``/development/applications``. Values only; polygons come from
``/shapes/mesh-blocks``.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**
name: suburbs_development_new_dwellings_map
title: Construction — new dwelling applications (by suburb)
